validation.notes: Ran from the workspace root with Node v24.14.0. The script loads the real submitted migrations.ts and core/session-manager.ts (plus the real utils/text.ts and utils/paths.ts) through the read-only .prale-eval/subject.mjs createSessionPipeline graph; only external boundaries (chalk, config helpers, keybindings module, message constructors) are substituted and the migration module's readdirSync is wrapped purely to make ordering deterministic. All assertions are uncaught node:assert/strict checks on observable bytes and cross-module behavior, using fixed timestamps/IDs and no real time, randomness, network, credentials or providers. Covered: (1) migration collision safety - a pre-existing destination stays byte-identical, the colliding agent-root source survives with its original bytes, an unrelated session still migrates to its session directory, and a repeated migration stays idempotent; (2) cross-module consumer checks - SessionManager.open on the migrated artifact returns the migrated header ID and cwd without rewriting it, and the preserved destination remains the session the reader sees; (3) a relocated header-shaped file lacking a string ID is rejected by loadEntriesFromFile and by SessionManager.open with its bytes untouched, even though it is unterminated; (4) a relocated valid session with an unterminated final record loads both entries and gains exactly one trailing newline, idempotently, and a terminated valid session is read without rewriting; (5) an unterminated malformed tail after a valid header is still repaired, preserving unrelated behavior. Fault isolation was verified by restoring each source file alone to its faulty baseline: with the migrations.ts baseline the run fails with the assertion error 'existing destination bytes must win a collision'; with the core/session-manager.ts baseline (conditional &&) the run fails with 'the reader must reject a header lacking a string ID' while every migration assertion passes. Both failures are assertion errors, not crashes, import errors or timeouts, so each module has an independent detector. Local fixtures are created under .prale-eval/tmp-session-integrity and removed both at the end of the run and from a process exit handler, so nothing remains in the workspace. Limitation: the repository's own vitest/tsc toolchain is not installed in this workspace (no node_modules) and installing dependencies was out of scope, so packages/coding-agent/test/session-manager/file-operations.test.ts and a typecheck could not be executed here; the required Node 24 regression script is the validation evidence and needs no optional dependency. No packages were installed.
